head.title: Ault Summer Festival 2023: Celebrate the Homegrown Spirit of Ault, Colorado
head.description: Join the Ault Summer Festival 2023 from August 4th-6th, an unforgettable weekend celebration in Ault, Colorado. Enjoy a range of family-friendly activities including parades, a car show, craft fair, live music, food trucks, fireworks, and more. Celebrate the homegrown spirit of our charming small town!
